format: Psion Series 3 AIK Audio (AICASoundFile) - nibble codebook
agent: Track C, R-5 follow-up to F-39 (F-44-or-next-free)

hypotheses_tested.name: IMA/DVI ADPCM (standard mapping, sign=bit3, 89-entry step table, index table [-1,-1,-1,-1,2,4,6,8])
hypotheses_tested.evidence: repeated silence code 5 decodes as +1.5*step ramp with index+4 per sample; silence tails (pure 0x55, 313-487 bytes) decode to tail_rms 27000-30700 of 32767 full scale in all 3 files; SFM -5 to -12 dB (noise-like)

hypotheses_tested.name: OKI/Dialogic (VOX) ADPCM (49-entry 12-bit table, same nibble convention)
hypotheses_tested.evidence: same silence contradiction: 16x code 5 ramps [2816, 6864, 12848, 21648, 32752...] to full scale; tail_rms 31200-32700

hypotheses_tested.name: Direct companded PCM (nibble = amplitude code, sign=bit3, L[5]=0)
hypotheses_tested.evidence: best of 5040 level permutations reaches only SFM -10.5 dB vs -20 to -23 dB for DPCM family; also contradicted by +/-1 blips of codes 4/12 amid hold codes at TETRIS_2 opener (clicks implausible for silence)

hypotheses_tested.name: Unit-step signed-magnitude DPCM: diff(code) = +/-L[mag], sign=bit3, L[5]=0
hypotheses_tested.evidence: per-256-nibble-frame reset decode: in-range fraction 0.995-0.996 (vs ~0.5 random-walk baseline) for a narrow perm family across all 3 files; decode is tonal (SFM -20 to -23 dB), bounded (clip 0.000-0.003), plausible 8-bit RMS 22-49

hypotheses_tested.name: Full-file predictor carry (no per-frame reset)
hypotheses_tested.evidence: no-clip cumsum never stays bounded (best 0.53); clip-carry decode drifts monotonically into the -128 rail (rms 105-114, clip 6-15%, range capped at -128..+14/+87) - rail-clipping harmonics inflate SFM, metric artifact identified

hypotheses_tested.name: Per-frame 1-byte predictor seed (frame = seed byte + 254 nibbles)
hypotheses_tested.evidence: silence frames (all-hold nibbles) decode to the seed DC value (sil_rms 85, e.g. 0xdd = -35), contradicting silence = zero; frame jumps 73-83

winner.max_level_code_asymmetry: code 2 (+7) occurs 0 times in 61440 nibbles while code 10 (-7) occurs 1015 times: consistent with L[2]=max level and one-sided saturation
winner.residual_ambiguity: exact assignment of levels {0..3} among mags {0,1,7} and L[3]=3 vs 4, L[4]=5 vs 6: top candidates within 0.5 dB SFM; needs known-content AIK to pin
winner.mirror_stat_support: nibble counts of bit3 mirror pairs nearly equal (e.g. 0/8 = 3932/3952, 3/11 = 5372/5207 in TETRIS_2), confirming sign-bit structure; pairs (5,13) and (2,10) asymmetric, explained by zero/saturation roles

validation.pitch: melodic f0 tracks recovered (descending sequences, lags 5-30 samples); several near-exact equal-tempered fits at 8192 Hz (292.6 Hz vs D4 293.7, 390.1 vs G4 392, 327.7 vs E4 329.6)
open_items: frame-boundary discontinuities in reset decode (mean jump 26-70 vs median sample step 2) unexplained - suggests a per-frame state mechanism not yet recovered
rate 4096 vs 8192 not arbitrated (pitch-ratio structure is rate-invariant); 8192 Hz favored only by census N-unit hypothesis
